note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the scenes differ in one supplied fact only, nothing is added up and no winner, share or outcome is shown. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision 2026-09-26: stress lengths capped to fit at 16 px (LAW-0687 precedent; see SESSION_HANDOFF).
